\begin{adjustwidth}{0cm}{6cm}First attempt which I had previuously given up because my dumbass forgot how to do basic math\\
\[\begin{aligned}
	&\text{Taylor Series}\\
	\frac{d\cos(i_1speed)}{dspeed} &=\frac{\left(1-\frac{(i_1 \cdot (speed+d))^2}{2!}+\frac{(i_1 \cdot (speed+d))^3}{3!}...\right)-\left(
	1-\frac{(i_1 \cdot speed)^2}{2!}+\frac{(i_1 \cdot speed)^3}{3!}...
	\right)}{d}\\
	&=\frac{-(i_1 \cdot (speed+d))^2+(i_1\cdot speed)^2}{2!d}+\frac{(i_1 \cdot (speed+d))^3-(i_1\cdot speed)^3}{3!d}...\\
	&=\frac{-(i_1speed+ i_1d)^2+i_1^2speed^2}{2!d}+\frac{(i_1speed+i_1d)^3-i_1^3 speed^3}{3!d}...\\
	&=\frac{-i_1^2speed^2 - 2i_1^2 \cdot speed\cdot d- i_1^2d^2+i_1^2speed^2}{2!d}+\frac{(i_1speed+i_1d)^3-i_1^3 speed^3}{3!d}...\\
	&=\frac{- 2i_1^2 \cdot speed\cdot d- i_1^2d^2}{2!d}+\frac{i_1^3speed^3+3i_1^3speed^2d+3speedi_1^3d^2+i_1^3d^3-i_1^3 speed^3}{3!d}...\\
	&=\frac{i_1d \cdot (-2i_1\cdot speed -i_1d)}{2!d}+\frac{i_1d\cdot(3i_1^2speed^2+3speedi_1^2d+i_1^2d^2)}{3!d}...\\
	&=\frac{-2i_1^2\cdot speed \cdot \cancel{d} -i_1^2\cancel{d}^2}{2!\cancel{d}}+\frac{3i_1^3speed^2\cancel{d}+3speedi_1^3\cancel{d}^2+i_1^3\cancel{d}^3}{3!\cancel{d}}...\\
 &=\frac{-2i_1^2\cdot speed -i_1^2d}{2!}+\frac{3i_1^3speed^2+3speedi_1^3d+i_1^3d^2}{3!}...\\
	\lim_{d\to 0}\cos(i_1speed)&=\frac{-2i_1^2\cdot speed}{2!}+\frac{3i_1^3 \cdot speed^2}{3!}...\\	
	&=\frac{-\cancel{2}i_1^2\cdot speed}{\cancel{2}\cdot 1!}+\frac{\cancel{3}i_1^3 \cdot speed^2}{\cancel{3} \cdot 2!}...\\	
	&=\frac{-i_1^2\cdot speed}{1!}+\frac{i_1^3 \cdot speed^2}{2!}...\\	
	&=i_1\cdot \frac{-i_1\cdot speed}{1!}+i_1\cdot\frac{i_1^2 \cdot speed^2}{2!}...\\	
	&=i_1\cdot \left(\frac{-i_1\cdot speed}{1!}+\frac{i_1^4 \cdot speed^4}{4!}...\right)\\
	&=i_1\cdot \left(\frac{-i_1\cdot speed}{1!}+\frac{i_1^3 \cdot speed^3}{3!}...\right)= -\sin(i_1speed)\cdot i_1\\
\end{aligned}\]
\end{adjustwidth}
\\begin{adjustwidth}{0cm}{10cm}leave only the even elements which i forgot to do at the start\n\\end{adjustwidth}
